company.name: Sphere
company.shortDescription: Sphere is an AI-powered cross border compliance platform
company.description:
Sphere is an AI-powered cross-border compliance platform. 

We help companies like Lovable, Eleven Labs, Replit and Windsurf automate their sales tax, VAT, GST compliance obligations. 

What makes us different to other vendors on the market is: 

1. we have spent the last 1.5 years building local rails into 100+ tax authorities in both the US and internationally to properly automate compliance processes, and 
2. we've built the world's first AI-native tax engine which ingests, codifies and monitors tax law globally.

productsAndServices.description: An AI-powered platform that automates and manages global sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance including monitoring, registration, tax calculation, filing, and remittance across multiple jurisdictions.
productsAndServices.name: Sphere Global Tax Compliance Platform

productsAndServices.description: A proprietary AI model trained on global tax laws to determine the taxability of products and services across jurisdictions in real-time.
productsAndServices.name: Tax Review and Assessment Model (TRAM)

productsAndServices.description: An AI system that analyzes product data to automatically assign correct tax codes across different tax jurisdictions.
productsAndServices.name: AI-Enabled Tax Code Assignment

productsAndServices.description: A tool that continuously tracks sales and business activities to alert companies when they approach or exceed tax registration thresholds in various jurisdictions.
productsAndServices.name: Real-Time Nexus Monitoring

productsAndServices.description: AI agents that prepare, validate, and submit tax registrations and filings to tax authorities automatically across multiple jurisdictions.
productsAndServices.name: Automated Tax Registration and Filing Agents

productsAndServices.description: A system to collect, track, and validate exemption certificates from customers to ensure proper tax exemption handling.
productsAndServices.name: Exemption Certificate Management
